nom: TONYMOLY Tako Pore Blackhead Scrub Stick

avis.texte: I really wanted to love this because the packaging is so cute! It cleaned my skin ok and didn't break me out, but I found that it didn't exfoliate my skin. I just saw myself keeping it because of the cute packaging, but I actually reached for other exfoliants.

I have always had problem skin and clogged pores, but using this nearly daily, mainly on my nose, has changed my skin for the better in a way that nothing else ever has. Immediate difference after 1 use and more permanent changes after continuous use

At first wasn't sure it was working but you need to get through the smooth outer shell. Then the scrubbing texture can do its work! My nose was always full of whiteheads, now it's crazy smooth. Affordable & effective. Plus cute!

avis.titre: I love this cute little miracle worker!
avis.texte: It's not made to use daily or to replace your current face wash or exfoliant. But works perfectly when you have those stubborn blackheads all over and around your nose. I hate that I can no longer buy it in store. One lasted me about a month.
Great addition to my shower routine :) Not a miracle worker, but it definitely helps keep my pores clean.

avis.titre: The package is so cute and easy to use
avis.texte: II use often this one because it's simple to use. If you want to get rid of blackheads on a daily basis, I recommend it.

avis.titre: It's very gimmicky and doesn't work
avis.texte: All it really does is exfoliate, other then that it doesn't work.

The very first application was amazing; I'm convinced it worked. Every other application since, has been a disappointment. It doesn't actually do anything. Need to fulfill a stupid character quota so blah blah blahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

I got this product a while ago for the cute squid package! But to my surprise the ratings were mid so I was scared to use it but after a few days my blackhead was gone!!! I love this product and it's packaging and it smells delightful I hope this product gets more popular!!!:)

avis.titre: It's basically pumice in a stick
avis.texte: The description made it sound like it would be sticky or pull sebum out somehow, but it's really just a coarse physical exfoliant. I'd rather use a konjac sponge or washcloth with the same effect, since this was really hard on my skin.
Its cute and make my nose area feel soft but I still see my blackheads. I repurchased for my mom so i hope it works on her than on me lol.

Super cute but this only functions as a basic exfoliting scrub. When i bought this it had great reviews which I think are due to the product having all the tiny ?sugar? bits for exfoliating are HIDDEN underneath the top layer when you first open it, so it kind of tricks you into thinking all this sebum/whiteheads have been scrubbed off your face when in reality as you use it and it wears down, you start to see that it's actually just the makeup of the product. I still use it time to time to help exfoliate dead skin around my nose, but the results are no different from any cheap scrub. It also leaves some greasy feeling residue that i end up washing away.

Super cute but this only functions as a basic exfoliting scrub. When i bought this it had great reviews which I think are due to the product having all the tiny ?sugar? bits for exfoliating are HIDDEN underneath the top layer when you first open it, so it kind of tricks you into thinking all this sebum/whiteheads have been scrubbed off your face when in reality as you use it and it wears down, you start to see that it's actually just the makeup of the product. I still use it time to time to help exfoliate dead skin around my nose, but the results are no different from any cheap scrub. It also leaves some greasy feeling residue that i end up washing away.
I bought this for my 14 yo daughter and she had really bad reactions to this, many pimples on her nose after the first use.
the product was amazing at first. exfoliating leaving my skin soft. i woke up the next day with pimples and rashes all over my nose. dont let the cute packaging fool you!!

I had SUCH high hopes for this esp since its cute and had good reviews for the most part but no. it painfully peeled off layers of skin around my nose and to top it all off, the parts it didnt burn, it didnt even cleanse. i thought something was up when it applied invisibly but oh well.

avis.titre: THIS PRODUCT IS CRAZY! I LOVE IT.
avis.texte: bought it on a whim, not expecting much, and wow!! they put magic in this lil guy. ive always struggled with filled to the brim pores, and this cleared them all out! my nose area feels AMAZING.
I was mind of scared to use product other reviews were kind of washy but over so glad i made this purchase

avis.titre: Not the best but not the worst!
avis.texte: Adorable packing. Smaller than I expected, but that makes it more cute. I just love the squid so much. It's lovely. As for if the squid does it's job, I would say yes but very slowly. If you want immediate amazing results then I would avoid this product, however, it did make my skin smoother. It smells wonderful, and it's gentle. Did somewhat take out blackheads, which is what I mean by it does it does its job slowly. Cute little guy. Can't get over the packaging.
The exfoliating "ball" broke off immediately on my first use. Super cute but not functional. I was not pressing hard either.

I saw this product reviewed in an online video months ago & the reviews were kind of luke warm. I took an impromptu trip to Ulta and found myself wanting to try this little guy because I am a SUCKER for cute, unique packaging. Im so glad i did! I have used so many different products over the years that are designed to remove blackheads and unclog pores, with very lack luster results. I can actually see a HUGE difference in all my typical problem areas (t-zone and chin) after once use with this product. My skin feels smooth and soft, but my pores are also mostly clear! I feel with regular, weekly or twice weekly use, this product will really make a difference. The only downside is the packaging is not in English, so I had to look up directions for use. Not a huge deal, really. Overall, I really loved this product and will purchase again.

avis.titre: Tako is one of the good ones
avis.texte: I like this product alot. The packaging is what caught my eye, adorable and self explanatory. My only complaint is, when I purchase a Tako (3 times now) two out of the three times the item was broken. I still managed to use what I could because I respect and like the formula alot. I have acne scars around my jawline and brokeout in that area often. This product really helps keep that at bay.

I read the instructions online, and although I didn't steam my face, I took a hot shower and then used it on my nose. My nose looks so clear! Works better than biore. I recommend using a face mask after and use this product 3 to 4 times a week as instructed on the directions .
I like how its made for application purposes and my pores feel refreshed after use
This product is a pleasant surprise to anyone that has tried/failed several blackhead removal remedies. I noticed results after the second use.

avis.titre: What the heck happened to this?
avis.texte: I used to use the product years ago, and i loved it. It disappeared a while back, so i was excited to be able to purchase it again. The product used to be about the size of a deodorant stick with a pore scrubber in the base. This new one is miniscule. Its the size of a lip balm and costs as much as the bigger one did. Really really disappointed in the size.
This product works to clear my blackheads. I use it 3-4 times a week after cleansing my face.

This little guy really works ! Nice grit without being too harsh! Follow instructions and you'll be pleased. I had decent amount of blackheads that are all gone now! Afterwards use I rinsed my face with a soft gel face cleanser to remove this scrubs residual.
round surface w very strong grains that exfoliate skin, this is especially good for the sides of your nose just dont push to hard
The scrub removed blackheads I didn't even know I had and is so easy to use

This product is not only cute - it works!! I have struggled with blackheads on my nose for years. Ill use this after a shower and ill re-wet my nose with hot water. After rubbing the stick around my nose I can literally see my pores unclogging. I will also gently glide my finger nails to push the excess gunk out of my pores. I use this stick about twice a week and it has made such a difference. It smells good and is fairly gentle. I do recommend using a light moisturizer afterwards because I notice if I don't my nose will be a little dry or flaky the next day. I have been using it for a month now and the product is holding up great. If you get bad blackheads on your nose please give this product a try. Its better and easier to use than the traditional pore strips. I am so happy to finally find a product that keeps my blackheads under control. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
I must have had a reaction to it or something. My skin is still peeling and burns where I used it.
The packaging is adorable. I was hoping this would help with stubborn blackheads on and around my nose, but after using 4x/week for a month, I haven't noticed a difference.
i absolutely LOVE this blackhead scrub stick. i use it a few times a week and i can see a difference! it's not very irritating, either, and it's a wonderful product overall. highly recommend! :)
I bought this for my boyfriend because he has stubborn blackheads that we're trying to tackle and it didn't affect the blackheads at all, it left his skin greasy but it did smell nice
packing is super cute, wish it wasn't so small though. leaves my face feeling extremely soft and clean afterwards. I have yet to see if it helps with my blackheads!

This is the first product that has ever worked on the obnoxious little whiteheads and blackheads I get around my lip line. After consistent (almost) daily use they all cleared up and no more have formed. I have dry, slightly sensitive skin and I haven't had any adverse effects

At first I wasn't sure if I was using it correctly, so, I used it on my 11 year old that has been developing blackheads. I literally watched the blackheads clear from her pores as I rubbed the stick over problem areas. She now wants her own!

I used this product until it ran out and it's pretty good. I have blackheads on my chin and nose and I use this when I wash my face every morning and every night. My blackheads ain't as dark and my nose feels a lot smoother in texture. So, overall I'm pretty happy with the results of using this product and I ordered me another one.

This is the cutest thing! But idk how effective it is. I've used it twice, and while I like the way my skin feels great afterward, it doesn't completely remove the blackheads. It does remove some, though, which is better than I can say for most other blackhead treatments. Overall, I'd recommend, especially for the price, but it's not a cure-all.
This is a great manual scrub to use a couple times a week. It is gentle and effective and I would say that it does clear out pores. That said, it is TINY and the product runs out very fast.

After every use a new pimple would pop up that would days weeks to completely clear. I don't usually write reviews even if it's just not for me. But this did more damage than good and Bleh. After a couple uses I also had to scrub it out. Wanted to be sure it was this product and not me, but there was a definite pattern. Be prepared if you purchase.

I bought this to mainly combat the blackheads on my nose. I have been wanting a product that will help cleanse my pores as I've noticed my nose looks so congested and I didn't want to purchase more abrasive pore stripes. This is very cute packaging wise, but I feel like that might be it. The first use was hard to tell if I was using correctly. I didn't feel like it cleaned anything. Now that I've used it a few times, the product has worn down now and is more abrasive on my nose. I don't know if that is supposed to happen with continued use, but I don't feel it really cleans my pores that well. I notice too that after using it, the corners of my nose feel a little raw. And I do notice that throughout the day I find a little pimple form from one of the pores. I think there must be something better out there that isn't too abrasive and will help get more of the gunk off my nose.

I had seen great views online for this product on multiple sites and struggle a lot with bad black heads, especially on my nose and nothing has worked. In one single use, the black heads have almost completely disappeared on my nose and chin. Excited to keep using this and seeing the problem finally disappear without waxing my nose with those painful strips.

my mom got me this for christmas, knowing i love skincare. i have used this multiple times and i honestly have to say this product is incredible! i recommend wetting your face a little bit before going in with the scrub stick, as it allows the stick to glide across your face easier, or using it in the shower for a more in-depth clean. i deal with very large pores on my nose, chin, and cheeks, therefore causing a large amount of sebaceous filiments. after using this product, my face is visibly smoother. i recommend using every few days, or adding it with your weekly masks/in depth exfoliation. this is one product that i will be keeping in my skincare regimen from now on!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again! Best ever for black heads.
avis.texte: I have only used this product for a couple of weeks and my black heads are already going away. My pores also seem to be tightening. Hands down the best product there is. Do not hesitate on buying this! You won't regret it!
It felt scruby, but left a residue even after washing off and caused me to get clogged pores worse than before use.

Nothing has ever gotten rid of the tiny white bumps under my lower lip. But this took care of them in one go. Its so smooth now. I am extremely skin sensitive and this didnt make me break out or anything. I think some people here have too bad of skin and are expecting miracles. For mild blackheads this works.
I used this every morning for 2 weeks. My nose looked like a graveyard! Terribly clogged pores. big red clogged pores. Please don't buy!!!

Saw that this was on clearance at Ulta and I loved how cute this was, so I thought, hey, why not give this a try? Plus, I've always heard great things about Korean beauty products so I thought that this might be a really great product. I didn't initially look at any reviews on this product before buying. I used it tonight and it really irritated my skin on my nose. My nose was really itchy after washing the grease layer produced from this stick; I even looked into the mirror to see if it really got any of the blackheads out of my nose but it doesn't really look any different before. It's only my first time using it, so I'm hoping that maybe after a few more uses, I'll see some changes or improvements. However, I just don't like how it irritated my skin and made it a little red. I had to wash my face again with warm water and soap which helped relieve the itchiness I felt after using this.

I was presently surprised how well this worked out for me. I have normal to dry skin. I have really stubborn white heads on my forehead and nose. This made my bumps on the forehead so smooth, from just one use. The bumps almost all went away by morning! It's amazing. The scrub is a bit harsh but I think it needs to. I have sensitive skin & this did not irritate it. The whiteheads on my nose smoothed out and there are no visable holes on my nose like most nose strips can do. Love so much! I bought many backups already. U need to use as directed though. 3-4x a week. Too bad it's small but it's mighty. I'm happy to final found something that helps rid my whiteheads.

I bought this because I've wanted to try the brand and never had anything help the clogged pores on my nose. I have always had large, clogged pores on my nose. Charcoal washes/masks barely do anything. Nose strips don't grab it all and leave holes in place of clogged pores. I opened this and noticed the instructions were in Korean. I knew it was a Korean product so I didn't care and just checked the website for instructions. I use it in my shower. I use my facial wash, like always, and rub this on my problem areas, mainly my nose. I use my silicon facial scrubber and work it in, then rinse and do my after care once I get out. I saw a difference immediately. After the second time I couldn't stop rubbing my nose because it was so smooth for the first time I could remember. It's a gentle product that gets them out without leaving holes like a pore strip. One of my favorite products in my routine now. I highly recommend it.

I bought this mostly cause I thought the packaging was cute. I have some blackheads in my t-zone and this one stubborn blackhead above my eyebrow. I thought haha maybe itll even get rid of that one. Oh my god. Ive had that blackhead for literal YEARS and NOTHING could get it remotely close to coming out. Hot towels, creams, pore strips, squeezing the hel out of it, NOTHING worked. But one use of this stick and it comes right out. LITERAL MAGIC. BUY THIS.

avis.titre: Best thing I've ever tried for my stubborn pores!
avis.texte: I have always have GIANT pores all along my nose and stubborn blackheads on my chin that would never budge or come up so I could get them out for anything. This product has not only made my pores significantly smaller, but it has made those stubborn blackheads on my chin come up to where I could get them out. This product has also made my skin MUCH smoother and it also smells phenomenal. I always jump out of the shower and scrub my face with this and then jump back in and rinse my face with colder water. This product has changed my face and I will continue to buy it.

I am in love. Not only cute but definitely does what it says it will do. Especially for this oily blemish prone skin of mine. Now that I have found this product, if I forget to buy more before running out my skin knows...and boy does my skin let me know! I will continue to purchase until the end of time and always making sure to have a spare can't hurt either! Thank you TONY MOLY and ULTA!

This cute little guy really works. Of course it's not magic, but use it every few days and keep it in your routine it really works. I use it on my whole t zone because that's where I get all my pimples and it helped with that too! Very fun and worth it
I've tried so many masks, strips and oils and this is the best one I've used. It actually took out so many. I was shocked. Gonna continue to buy. Oh and it's cute!

I've been using this twice a day for the past two weeks and I love it! It smells fresh and has helped clear up stubborn black heads around my nose. My only issue with it is that I'm almost out already. Maybe I'm using more than others? At any rate I'll just purchase another :)

I was skeptical from the beginning and it was confirmed I guess. The idea was cool, but I couldn't really see visible difference even after using after warm bath to open up pores. The container is cute. So, I'll probably keep it and make use of it and use the container for something else later.

I am prone to milia, the small bumps under the skin that have a white ball underneath. I have used this little scrubber for 3 days now and it has opened up a fairly good size bump that usually takes weeks to open up. So far it I has earned a spot in my skin care routine!

I'm 25 and have been looking for YEARS, Something to minimize and clean out my huge Greek pores. I've been seriously self conscious about the largeness of them since about 13 years old. I'm not one to leave reviews but this one l felt compelled to share. Usually I bargain shop and I was skeptical to spend $12 on this tiny little stick, but I've been so desperate and decided to just give it a shot. I'll NEVER use anything else for blackheads again. This is it! If I was able to make a suggestion though, the design is super cute, but there's not much product. The size as far as application is great, but it would be better if it were designed more so like a chapstick or deodorant to roll up more product as needed. Otherwise I'd give it 6 stars if possible. I'm also a huge fan of the Tako sebum gel by TonyMoly as well. They work great together.

I wash my face and after while my face is still wet just use this around lips, nose and chin. I broke out in white heads because is lifted all the grime out. Now beautiful clean skin. I use it for 30 seconds in each area. My sister lives and dies for this product too

avis.titre: Love Tako best for my face
avis.texte: My husband bought this for me to try after first try it made my face feel great. It got all the dirt and black heads after scrubing with it then using my fingers. Made my face feel soft. only thing I didn't like when I got to the bottom had break rest of it out to finsh using it.

I used it once, the past came out super black and worked really well on my skin! I went to use it again a couple days later, the paste has turned gray and transparent and doesn't work as well now. I feel like maybe it went bad? I'm very disapointed and feel like I didn't get my money's worth. :(
i used it twice and now my skin is covered in red, itchy painful bumps!!

Horrible! This thing made me breakout all over my nose and face. Only thing that was different in my face wash routine. My nose hurts so bad from the breakout! I always had "nice" skin and rarely breakout but this made me breakout so bad!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: First thing I do when I get out of the shower! I love this convenient scrub stick. Easy to scrub on and rinse off. I wish I would have found this years ago.

Did nothing for me. Was disappointed in the size and amount of product I received for the price. I used as directed and it leaves a film on my skin, almost like a layer of grease. Initially it has this weird layer over the product that is hard to get off and actually use the product underneath. IMO, not worth the results, size and cost.
I love this my blackheads are actually diminishing with this product. I use it once in the morning everyday.
after the first use I could already see some smaller pore looked smaller. I thought maybe it was in my head but after a few days the bigger pores were smaller too! This is a must have for me

My two teen boys use this. They had icky blackheads and a few (literally 2-3) uses and i noticed a remarkable improvement in their pores and black heads! I will definitely keep buying this guy. Plus the boys love it cause he looks like the little Snapchat ghost to them.

Love this !!! I was using the tarte exfoliating stick which I love.. I ran out and my blackheads on nose and chin have been horrible. So was just walking around ulta found this the packaging is cute it's small but def worth it I have noticed a difference in my skin! Will buy again

I love this little guy! Like most reviews say, use it for a few seconds like 29 seconds to get to the scrubby beads. I noticed an immediate difference and just to see what would happen I took a little blackhead remover to some of the stubborn spots I have and while some did come out (much easier) most were gone! Definitely a must have

i got acne prone, sensitive skin and let me tell you, I only bought this yesterday and it's already removed like 50% of my blackheads. It was nasty and satisifying. i had more tham 2 people on my snap asking me about this product bc my skin WAS POPPIN. it smells good, works well and FEELS GOOD. i love this line toly moly has.

This lil dude does some great exfoliation of my skin. At first use I didn't get to the gritty part that exfoliates...I got to it a few uses in. This lil cleanser feels like a balm and it makes extractions easier by attracting the sebum/blackheads closer to the surface of my skin...this is what I use it for. It's easy to handle. It also leaves my skin feeling nice, clean, & hydrated (not dry). And it fits in many places BC its so small! I don't need to use it everyday...maybe once/WK so it has lasted me awhile- I still have plenty!

I have combination, acne-prone, sensitive skin that is prone to hyperpigmentation and deep, long-lasting pimples. I'm very fair and in my early thirties. This product is fantastic! While I have all the Tako products and love them, this was my first purchase due to the price point. I wish this was a full-sized cleanser, because that is what I use it for. I don't use it every day, unless I am focusing on a target area. The sea salt and marine extracts are remarkably soothing on problem skin. My skin is never red or irritated after using this, and I am unable to use facial scrubs. My skin is velvety and perfectly moisturized after rinsing this off, and the smell is lovely. This also does not taste bad like the Tako cleansing stick, if you are using it around your lips. Please keep carrying this, as I can never be without it!

I have really stubborn blackheads and usually have to get a deep cleansing facial to get my skin completely clear. It's rare that I ever find a product that works or keeps working but this surprised me. You do have to scrub for a good 20 to 30 seconds before the scrub beads surface but once they do I scrub my t zone for a minute. It didn't immediately remove blackheads but the more you use it the more they get smaller and smaller or they're completely gone depending on how stubborn they are. It's small but will last a fairly long time and I prefer this and the gel over any of the other tako pore stuff.

this is a scrub stick, meaning that instead of using a typical scrub in a jar, you rub the product on your wet skin to exfoliate, kind of like an exfoliating chapstick but for your face. it is very convenient and not messy. i have noticed a difference in the pores on my nose but not so much on my chin or forehead. contrary to what some of these reviews are saying, your blackheads do not stick to the product! the little dots on the product are the exfoliating ingredients! the reason you do not see it when you first use it is because the exfoliants are under a smooth layer of product. additionally, if the product does not work the first time you use it, this could be due to you not reaching the exfoliating layer. it should start out smooth, rub it on the back of your wet hand until you begin to feel it scrubbing, then it should be ready for use.

I thought I'd give this a try because I had a coupon and the packaging is adorable. I had seen reviews that it worked, and I agree. I have stubborn blackheads on my nose constantly and some on my chin. After the first use the nose ones were near gone, the chin are still there, but I'll keep trying. Happy enough with the nose results!

I love this product. I just bought it and my skin looks clean. Mind you that I have really large pores and this got rid of most of it. Great product. Will buy this product again. Only problem is that it's small/less than I thought. And I can't really get rid of my pores on the stick. Try to wash it off but it's still there.

Ive used this a handful of times, and I still havent noticed a difference or change. Make sure that when you use it for the first time you run it under water til the white little beads start to surface. I believe these are what helps to exfoliate. It smells great, packaging is very adorable, but I dont think i will be buying this again because of it's ineffectiveness for my skin.
all my blackheads and oil filled pores are cleaner than ever. love this lil guy

What a great little thing! He's tiny (about the size of an eos lipbalm) but is a big help! Just rub this little guy on you're problem areas to gently exfoliate out the gunk! I use mine next to my nose and in my chin where my pores are biggest and prone to clogging. The product itself is black and feels nice on the skin. One note is that you have to run off the top layer of product to get to the little white bumps that are the exfoliaters (some people mistake this for the stuff coming out of their pores). It's been a test addition to my skin care routine and since you only use it on when needed on small spots he lasts a long time; which makes the price more worth it
just received this today, it wasn't what i expected🤷🏻‍♀️ product to small!!

The packaging is adorable. The scent is pleasant. Size is small. This item is pretty pricey when you consider that it needs to be used in addition to your regular skin care routine in order to get any results. I've been using it 4x a week for a month, and the difference is very subtle. I can tell it helps exfoliating, helps the skin feel smooth, but doesn't penetrate below the surface to help with blackheads.

I literally never write reviews but I had to for this. This stuff is amazing. I have always hated my nose and chin because of blackheads. I've tried i feel like everything and never had results. That was until I used this. In one week my blackheads are significantly decreasing. Will continue to purchase.
Doesn't work like the other comments state, but it does make your skin feel softer after use
I read a lot of great reviews, but it doesn't seem to work for me? I'll go with someone else!

It's tiny, but the size isn't what bothered me. I bought this after reading the reviews and a few people said they could see what was pulled from their pore right on the stick. I thought noooooooo way I need to try it. Bought it, tried it as soon as I got it and was like holy poop! 😱 There was a ton of it on the little black stick. So I tried wiping the stick off and it didn't move. So here I am, trying for the 4th time and I decided to cut the stick from the base to see if the particles are really from my face or the stick itself. (And since the stick is truly less than an inch big I knew it wouldn't make a difference cutting it down) And the particles everyone is saying that's coming from their pores is truly some ingredient throughout the stick. So far I haven't noticed a crazy difference, if any at all other than my nose and chin is smooth as a baby's bottom. I am crossing my fingers I see a difference in the near future. If not, it was worth a try.

I can already tell after my first use that this will be a holy grail beauty product! It is small but this little guy will last a long time! Has great scrubbing power so it doesn't take much product. Where has this been all my life!

This little guy sucks the dirt right out of your pores! It blows everything else out of the water! My pores have never been this clean! I've also noticed my pores are getting smaller. So much love for this product.

This little pore stick has worked wonders! Not wanting to use a harsh peel on my skin to pull out the blackheads, I bought this cute little guy on impulse during a visit to Ulta. Emphasis on small, but a little goes a long way. Noticed a significant difference on the first use! Wet your face, rub gently on problem spots, and rinse! Smells a bit weird, but in a tea tree oil sort of way that isn't bad!
I was sad of how small the product is but it sure did not disappoint. I used it on my nose and the blackheads were disappearing. my nose is so soft! would buy it again!

So, I always have had trouble with black heads on my nose and chin - nothing would work from face washes to masks to nose strips but this little stick is amazing. I have used it about 4 times and I can ready see a big difference! Can't wait to see more results.
I bought this as a gift for someone and I'm really disappointed in how expensive it is for the size of this
such cute packaging and it really opens up my pores especially around my nose and under my bottom lip.
Really works! I have large nose pores and this really helps clean them out and minimize how noticeable they are up close. Plus, smells amazing, is cute and cheap!
This little guy is amazing! It sucks all sorts of gunk out of the pores on my nose!

I love this pore cleaner! I could see the gunk being removed while I was using. I found it best to use a circular motion. After using I washed my face and put on a hydrating gel to cool my skin. I can see this being irritating if used every day I would recommended once a week.

I got this and totally forgot about it. Yesterday I was looking in the mirror after I washed my face and I had some major dark pores. So I thought I would try it and see if it helped. The box isn't in english so I didn't know to start with a wet face, but it worked anyways! Its like a chapstick and you just rub it lightly over your trouble spots and almost like a magnet the gunk comes out of your pores and onto the stick. I thought maybe it was a grainy exfoliating as I used it but it was my pores. So cool! I rinsed and put on lotion and I am good to go. I could see that it might be a little drying if you use it too often.

I was a bit nervous about this because I saw a few not so good reviews, but it's fantastic! Works absolutely great, saw results after just one use. And smells good too! Only downside is he's extra cute so he's attractive to kids haha

I was on the fence about purchasing this because the reviews online were about 50/50. I took a chance because it was on sale and I was not disappointed. The head of the octopus unscrews for the "pore solution." It's a stick that, the more you scrub, little bumps get revealed. After letting it sit a minute or two my nose felt a bit tingly. I noticed a major difference when I checked my face even after the first use. I applied it after my washing my face and then rinsed off the product a few minutes after applying it. I'm definitely going to get another as a gift as soon as they're back in stock. I really love this.
